predecessors.name: Qin dynasty
predecessors.text: Zhao Xie's rebel Zhao around Julu in central Hebei, 208-207, before it became Dai

successors.name: Kingdom of Han (Liu Bang)
successors.text: Zhao Xie's Zhao and Chen Yu's Dai in 205: the Dai lands plus Changshan taken from Zhang Er

rulers.name: Zhao Xie
rulers.title: King of Zhao; King of Dai from 206; King of Zhao again in 205

ledger.x: 208: Zhao Xie's Zhao stands in central Hebei.
207: the Qin army is beaten at Julu.
206: Xiang Yu makes Zhao Xie King of Dai.
206: the Zhao core goes to Zhang Er.
206: the Kingdom of Dai in the north.
205: Chen Yu takes Changshan and restores Zhao.
205: Han Xin conquers Dai and Zhao.

wars.name: Battle of Julu
wars.outcome: Qin besieged Zhao Xie at Julu; Xiang Yu's relief army beat Zhang Han's Qin army in 207 and Zhang Han surrendered that summer.

wars.name: Chen Yu's seizure of Changshan
wars.outcome: Chen Yu, with Qi's help, drove Zhang Er out of Changshan and restored Zhao; Zhang Er fled to Liu Bang.

wars.name: Han Xin's conquest of Dai and Zhao
wars.outcome: Han victory at Jingxing (October 205): Dai taken, Chen Yu and Zhao Xie killed; Handan was captured in 204 and Zhang Er was made King of Zhao.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary of the Zhao or Dai lands; Cliopatria's shapes are approximations.
